The Concept

A declaration,
not a description.

"It Ends With Me" is more than a podcast name — it is a statement. A declaration that certain patterns, cycles, and inherited pain stop here, with the person choosing to say so.

The brand needed to carry that weight without becoming heavy. Warm and intimate — the way a conversation between close friends feels — while being distinctive enough to hold its own in a crowded podcast landscape.

The visual identity draws from the brand's dual nature: burgundy carries depth and conviction. Gold signals worth and faith. Cream keeps everything breathable — never austere, always approachable.

"The cycle stops here. Not with anger — with intention. With the quiet certainty that what was inherited does not have to be carried forward."

Logo System

Five marks.
One identity.

The primary mark is a circular badge — the "iewm" monogram at the centre, "IT ENDS WITH ME · PODCAST" curved around it. Structured like a seal, worn like a signature. Designed in five distinct colourways so the brand can flex across every surface without ever losing itself.

Mark usage

Wordmark & Monogram

Two voices.
One brand.

Typography note

The wordmark is set in a bold retro serif — each letter full of curve and character. "it" sits small and deliberate above the sweep of "ends", which breaks wide and dominant. "with" steps in at a smaller weight, and "me" closes with the widest letterforms — the word that matters most, given the most space.

The iewm monogram condenses this into a single stacked mark — built for square formats, profile pictures, and anywhere the full wordmark can't breathe.

Burgundy is the brand's backbone — the colour of deep conviction, of faith that has been tested. It commands without shouting.

Gold is warmth and worth. It never screams — it glows at the edges of the brand. Cream is the exhale — always present, never competing.
